s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic cutaneous lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Asymptomatic cutaneous lesions on the face, trunk, and extremities
Monomorphic keratotic papules and symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques
key_facts: Lesions progressively spread to the trunk and extremities
Multiple millimetric erythematous to hyperpigmented monomorphic keratotic papules
Symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples
Mild anemia with hemoglobin level of 11.3 g/dL
Positive anti-Smith, SSA/Ro, SSB/La, and anti-U1RNP antibodies

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic cutaneous lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Asymptomatic cutaneous lesions on the face, trunk, and extremities
Monomorphic keratotic papules and symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques
key_facts: Lesions progressively spread to the trunk and extremities
Multiple millimetric erythematous to hyperpigmented monomorphic keratotic papules
Symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples

Positive anti-Smith, SSA/Ro, SSB/La, and anti-U1RNP antibodies

shortlist.label: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-Smith, SSA/Ro, SSB/La, and anti-U1RNP antibodies, and characteristic skin lesions

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Raised levels of antinuclear antibodies, hypocomplementemia, and moderate proteinuria

shortlist.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Characteristic skin lesions, although less likely given systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Mixed connective tissue disease
shortlist.why_kept: Overlap of lupus and rheumatoid arthritis features, with positive anti-U1RNP antibodies

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin lesions and asthenia, although lack of muscle weakness and specific autoantibodies makes it less likely

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of multiple millimetric erythematous to hyperpigmented monomorphic keratotic papules and symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples, along with positive anti-SSA/Ro antibodies and raised levels of antinuclear antibodies, is consistent with subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus. The absence of systemic symptoms and negative results for anti-dsDNA antibodies and lupus anticoagulant also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient lacks systemic symptoms and has negative results for anti-dsDNA antibodies and lupus anticoagulant, which are common in systemic lupus erythematosus

rejected.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient's lesions are not limited to the scalp, face, and ears, and the presence of symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples is more characteristic of subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus

rejected.label: Mixed connective tissue disease
rejected.why: The patient's presentation lacks a combination of features from multiple autoimmune diseases, such as scleroderma, polymyositis, and rheumatoid arthritis, which are typical of mixed connective tissue disease

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: The patient does not have muscle weakness or other symptoms of dermatomyositis, and the skin lesions do not have the characteristic features of dermatomyositis, such as Gottron's papules or heliotrope rash
